name: detectai-worker-analytics (${environment})
description: Analytics consumer: queue analytics.usage, dedup, DB writes. service.name = worker-analytics.

pages.name: Worker analytics
pages.description: Consumer lag, processing duration, retries, DB writes

rawConfiguration.text:
## Worker analytics (`worker-analytics`, `${environment}`)
Queue `analytics.usage`, dedup prefix `analytics:usage:event:`, sampler `traceidratio 0.1` (counts are sampled — use rates). Watches: stopped consumer (no ack 10m), DLQ/poison growth, DB write errors.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `msgs/min` WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS `poison` WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%Invalid analytics%' OR message LIKE '%poison%' OR message LIKE '%DLQ%' OR message LIKE '%dead-letter%')

FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%ack%' OR message LIKE '%nack%' OR message LIKE '%consum%') FACET message TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 8
FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET name TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 8
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS rpm, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET name LIMIT 20

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%Unhandled rejection%' OR message LIKE '%uncaughtException%' OR level = 'error') FACET message LIMIT 20

FROM Metric SELECT average(process_runtime_nodejs_eventloop_lag_ms) AS `loop lag ms`, average(process_heap_used_bytes / 1000000) AS `heap MB` WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (`http.route` = '/ready' OR name LIKE '%ready%') TIMESERIES AUTO
